question: Does the current 5V module/protection/contact stack leave enough voltage for a specified feeder, before committing to wire routing?
user_requirement: Manufacturable prototype design; no specified wire gauge or 4.75V terminal target
method: DC series-drop accounting at existing model comparison currents, not hardware or transient qualification
efuse_limitation: Table maximum specified at3A; applying at4.917A is an unqualified comparison
reverse_fet_limitation: 25C VGS2.5V table value; actual gate bias and hot resistance unqualified

wire_comparison.length_basis: Design comparisons only; not extracted from CAD routes

stopping_condition: Calculate residual for both motor types and lengths; reject routes with negative comparison budget; positive residual does not pass unknown losses. Do not run speculative transient simulation or adjust voltage target.
